post_topic: Kubernetes default-reach problem: teams treating orchestration as a deploy pipeline fix
scene_description: A cracked, tangled pipeline labeled 'Broken CI/CD' feeds directly into a large Kubernetes logo, with the same cracks and knots visibly continuing out the other side — nothing is fixed, only scaled up. On one side of the image, a cluttered diagram shows mismatched environments and inconsistent deploys; on the other, the same chaos is now surrounded by additional layers labeled Deployments, ReplicaSets, Ingress controllers, RBAC, and liveness probes. The contrast makes clear that Kubernetes inherited the original problem rather than solving it.
